sources: Joyal, Cossette & Lapierre (2015), What exactly is an unusual sexual fantasy?, Journal of Sexual Medicine 12(2), 328–340 – 1,516 adults in Quebec (799 women, 717 men); 85.1% heterosexual, 3.6% homosexual (women 6%, men 1.5%), rest bisexual; item 'I have fantasized about having homosexual (or gay) sex': women 36.9%, men 20.6% (whole sample, not straight-only).
